course_name: 語料庫語言學與英語教學
outline: This course offers an introduction to corpus linguistics, including the corpus analytical tools, techniques, corpus design and construction, and methodologies for doing corpus-based studies. We will also discuss its applications in English language teaching and learning. Major topics include vocabulary teaching and learning, analysis of chunks, teaching materials analysis, interlanguage analysis, discourse analysis, and computer-assisted language learning. Students are expected to learn to collect corpora data, create a small corpus, run and analyze corpora data according to different research topics.
schedule:
A detailed syllabus will be distributed on the first day of class.
W1. Course orientation; Introduction to corpus linguistics
W2. Applications of corpora in language learning & research
W3. Building a corpus: What are the key considerations?
W4. Corpus analytical tools: Wordsmith, AntConc, Wmatrix
W5. Holiday
W6. Corpora and vocabulary: the analysis of chunks
W7. Corpora and grammar: lexis and patterns; Spoken grammar
W8. Listenership and response; Relational language
W9. Academic and business corpora
W10. Exploring teacher corpora; What can a corpus tell us about language teaching
W11. Multi-modal corpora: Language and gestures
W12. Corpora and discourse analysis
W13. Mini-conference: Project Proposal Presentation
W14. Learner corpus research
W15. Corpora and ESP – with guest speakers
W16. Holiday
W17. Computer assisted language learning
W18. Final presentation
assessment:
Participation & Selected Paper Discussion: 30%
Research Presentation: 30%
Final paper (project): 40%
